title: Blog 3 days a week, Google searches as link words, form activity
changes: From 1 November the server writes blog posts again on Monday, Wednesday and Friday (one a day, 11:00 Pakistan time), going on with the category plan and all its rules

CMS > Indexing > Search queries: what people search on Google (Search Console, last 4 weeks, only gaming and PC searches) and which page it shows; searches that are shown often but not on page 1 are marked Opportunity

Blog, news and guide posts link our other pages where they name them (up to 5 a post): pages Google has not indexed yet first, with the words people search as the link text, then products and categories

The blog writer gets the real Google searches that fit each post; questions about a product category where ROC is not on page 1 yet become new blog topics (at most 3 a day, never adult, gambling, piracy or cheat searches)
CMS > Live activity also shows logins, sign-up codes, password resets and every form message with name, email, form and page
The weekly email and the indexing email come from "Run On Console Updates" <alerts@runonconsole.com>; the test email has no [Test] in the subject
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/ and unzip it.
